notEquivalentPolicies: DateUtil gameCloseClock=02:00 is used by generic isRegardAsYesterday/getPassedDays and event closing helpers.
LocalCache.getWeeklyVersion selects Friday by calendar date and already changes at Friday 00:00.
Neither helper is the weekly diamond-task Friday 06:00 reset.
Shop weeks/months/quarters declared as server-opening boundaries do not acquire a 06:00 hour from diamond tasks.
28/84-day exchange-center periods are not natural calendar months/quarters without anchors.

sharedShopRuleScope.quarterly: Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct day 1 server opening; hour unknown

sharedShopRuleScope.rollingPeriods: EC 4-week/12-week periods stay distinct from natural month/quarter
